newsitem.title: MACAU: China has no plans to station PLA in Macau.
newsitem.headline: China has no plans to station PLA in Macau.

text.p: Beijing has no plans to station troops in Macau after the Portuguese-run territory reverts to China in 1999, Macau news reports on Sunday quoted a senior Chinese official as saying.

The reports said the director of China's Hong Kong and Macau affairs office, Lu Ping, told European parliament members during a visit to Brussels last week that Macau was too small to warrant a garrison.

An 40-member advance guard of People's Liberation Army (PLA) troops rolled in Hong Kong last Monday to prepare for the arrival of a Chinese garrison after the the British colony reverts to China at midnight June 30.
Macau, a Portuguese outpost for more than 400 years, measures just 21 sq km (eight sq miles), a fraction of the 1,067 sq km (412 sq miles) occupied by Hong Kong.
